presence.freight_description: 5000 kg of 3300 kcal/kg edible cereal equivalent per source per model bin; prescribed capacity, not a cart/ship estimate

mobility.scope: Four fixed resource landscapes, one unsplit herd per independent experiment. Fresh growth plus finite carried feed; no unvisited standing-forage bank, fishing, human diet, herd demography or political classification. Water filter is proximity sensitivity, not known drinkable volume/permanence.

specification.scope: Hypothetical food support and seasonal herd resource circuits, not actual staffing, nutrition, sovereignty, populations, ethnicities, camps or rights of access. No food/feed outputs added to existing carrying capacity totals. All numerical budgets are scenario assumptions.

layers.label: Sustained presence
layers.note: Hypothetical food support and seasonal herd resource circuits, not actual staffing, nutrition, sovereignty, populations, ethnicities, camps or rights of access. No food/feed outputs added to existing carrying capacity totals. All numerical budgets are scenario assumptions. Single wheat/barley crop, rural meals protected before collection; no rice, millet, dates, second crop, animals, fish or external imports. Grey does not mean empty or uninhabitable.

layers.label: Seasonal circuits
layers.note: One unsplit herd of 100 dry-matter reference units; 7-day carried feed, actual transit meals before arrival, no free initial stock. Fresh growth at the selected destination is used once; unused growth expires. Water distances do not establish potable volume, permanence or access rights. Scenarios run independently; they are not jointly allocated herds or predicted communities.
